name: product-manager-os-routing
doc: Tiered model routing for the Product Manager OS. Contract, doctrine, and setup live in routing/README.md. Values in ${VAR} form are resolved from the environment by the caller; never commit resolved values.

extraction.purpose: Mechanical transforms where the answer is checkable: pull fields from documents, normalize backlogs, tag and summarize sources, convert formats, check a draft against a template's field list.

drafting.purpose: First complete drafts of structured artifacts: fill one named template from supplied evidence, write ADRs, produce diagrams-as-code, restructure a document without changing its claims.

judgment.purpose: Work where being wrong is expensive and unverifiable locally: prioritization calls, premortems, red-team passes, gap analyses, gate reviews, anything a human will sign.

fixedFallback.doc: Optional recipe for deployments that must pin exact models instead of auto tiers. Replace the placeholders with model IDs your OmniRoute instance serves, in preference order; the first available model in the list is used. Leave enabled false to stay on auto tiers.

limits.doc: Fail closed: at the cap, halt the tier and queue the work; never overspend and never silently downgrade judgment work to a cheaper tier.
